name: רעידת אדמה ועדכון באזהרת המסע
description: 28.11, Chiang Dao cave in the morning, then the drive to Doi Chang. At 09:20 a M5.6 quake hits 60 km from the cave; a small M4.6 nearby and a strong one in Japan should be ignored. At 10:05 the UK travel advice changes for the Chiang Rai border area. Expect two urgent pushes and a red day.

quake.place: 30 km NE of Chiang Dao, Thailand

events.note: A small M4.6 quake nearby (below the alert threshold)

quake.place: off the coast of Honshu, Japan

events.note: A strong quake far away (should be ignored)

advisory.description: Advice against all but essential travel to areas within 10 km of the Myanmar border in Chiang Rai province, after clashes near Mae Sai.
